content: Sharer and musician; master to Sam Latchet
One word, again, is enough to make a second reading, and the tenth line is where his mouth joins.
He will stop the author at a boy's entrance, because the boy has read a roll and not the play.
He offers mornings, and he does not dress the offer up as a cure.
He opened the mornings, nursed the call, and would not report them done.
He will count the mornings once, and he will not tell the boy there is another boy.
